in_marathi.name: Tapan
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Sun, radiant, shining
in_marathi.long_meaning: Tapan हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Derived from the Sanskrit word ‘Tapas’, meaning ‘heat’ or ‘shining’, Tapan refers to the sun god. The name symbolizes radiance, brilliance, and the power to illuminate. In Hindu mythology, Tapan is also associated with the god Agni, the deity of fire, and represents courage and purification.
